maya: quick sync — q-canary (quantized q4b) went to canary last night and we're seeing a small but consistent quality regression on the summarization promptset v3 :thinking_face:
jon: do you have an example prompt/result? could be tokenizer/rounding mismatch after quant or a cache seed issue :eyes:
maya: gist repro below, reproduces on my local harness with cpu fallback. small patch to quant kernel fixes logits but not rouge delta. sample: `promptset_v3/summary/idx_482`
maya: ```
# run eval locally
./eval_harness --model checkpoints/q4b-canary --prompts data/promptset_v3/summary.jsonl --metrics rouge
```
liam: ran quick check — this sample appears in our augmented ingest batch from 2026-02-12. there's ~0.7% overlap with golden anchors after fuzzy dedupe (sha similarity threshold 0.88). could be leakage inflating baseline quality, so the regression is relative to leaked golden examples being re-used differently with quantized model.
anya: labeler heads up — if we need to relabel, I can carve out a 500-sample golden audit. current capacity: +2 FTE today, +4 tomorrow. suggested: re-run on holdout subset first. :calendar:
jon: also try toggling `--use-kv-cache=false` in harness, and run with float16 reference model to confirm quant noise vs model mismatch. if float16 matches previous, blame quant path.
maya: thanks — i'll run `--use-kv-cache=false` now and post results in 10m. also adding a canary tag: `qcanary-172880` for traceability.
deploy-bot: model q4b-canary deployed to canary pool (tag: qcanary-172880) — 6 instances, region: us-west-2.
maya: quick update — disabling KV cache reduced the rouge gap by ~0.02 but didn't fully close it. when we filter out the overlapping anchors (liam's list) the gap disappears on the remaining holdout. this points to dataset leakage affecting our evaluation baseline.
liam: i'll produce a dedup delta and a short script to re-sample golden anchors excluding any items with fuzzyhash >= 0.86. putting PR together: `git@repo:curation/dedupe-scripts#remove-leaks`
anya: once we have a cleaned golden subset, i can re-run label audits and do a small relabel sprint (200/day). propose priority: summarization -> instructions -> chat completions.
maya: plan: (1) liam pushes de-dupe filter, (2) we re-eval canary on cleaned golden set, (3) if regression persists run quant kernel toggle + model -> escalate to infra. tagging @jon for kernel debug. sound good? :thumbsup:
jon: yep, i'll start digging into kernel quant ranges and pull perf traces. if needed we'll revert the canary and rerun with controlled holdout.
liam: PR opened with dedupe patch and sample list: https://git.internal/curation/pulls/182 — includes `leak_list.tsv`.
maya: thanks team — i'll wait for the cleaned results before opening a regression incident. keeping notes in the canary doc: https://confluence.redwood/qcanary/172880
anya: noted — will standby for relabel kickoff.
maya: closing loop once we have final numbers. short and focused thread, appreciate the quick responses! :sparkles:
